title: Sources: a draft White House EO would create a "voluntary framework" for AI companies to give government agencies early access to models before public release (Ashley Gold/Axios)
summary: Ashley Gold / Axios: Sources: a draft White House EO would create a “voluntary framework” for AI companies to give government agencies early access to models before public release — The White House plans to release its much-discussed executive order on cybersecurity and AI safety as soon as this week …
